parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for the details—and I’m sorry this is impacting reporting for ~40 enterprise customers. Given that the Salesforce production sync started failing immediately after the v2.8 upgrade and the logs show repeated auth token refresh errors, we’re treating this as a critical integration issue and will escalate to our engineering team to investigate the v2.8/auth-token refresh path.

To help us get to the right fix quickly, could you share the following from the failing sync logs?
1) The exact auth token refresh error message(s) and any error codes (paste 5–10 representative lines).
2) Whether this is failing for all Salesforce connections/tenants or only certain ones (please list the tenant names/org IDs or counts).
3) The timestamp when failures began relative to the upgrade, and whether any Salesforce/OAuth credential/config changes were made during/after the upgrade.
4) The affected environment details (prod vs sandbox, region, and whether you’re syncing to Salesforce production only).

In parallel, our team will review your logs and the v2.8 changes around Salesforce sync and authentication. We’ll follow up with what we find and the next steps to restore successful sync.
